about: Skousen, Gulbrandsen & Patience PLC is a personal injury firm with a single office in Mesa.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

json_ld_descriptions: Skousen, Gulbrandsen & Patience, PLC has served the residents of Mesa, Arizona and the surrounding area for 60 years. We love being a part of this community. Our team of injury lawyers in Arizona helps victims of accidents and those who have lost loved ones. We never work for insurance companies because we want to help people just like you through the challenges that often occur after an accident. A Mesa personal injury lawyer from our law firm will fight to protect that dignity and your rights. Schedule an appointment with one of our Mesa personal injury lawyers today to learn more about how our team can help.
